tools.name: get_code_target
tools.description: Read frozen target_metadata. Omitted or empty selection returns all eligible records, paged. Continue with cursor alone; copy complete natural keys from prior results. Unknown keys fail; no database queries or new measurements.
tools.output: Shared {items,next_cursor,is_complete,incomplete_object_key} envelope. Singleton variables return one item. Same record shapes as the variable, complete records; incomplete_object_key always null. Record paging retains complete records; default application byte ceilings are disabled.
